items.title_cn: 预防内镜逆行胰胆管造影术后胰腺炎的药物及内镜干预
items.title_en: Pharmacologic and Endoscopic Interventions for Prevention of Post Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 背景：内镜逆行胰胆管造影术后胰腺炎（PEP）是ERCP最主要且具有临床意义的并发症，导致相当大的发病率和医疗负担。药物预防和内镜预防策略均已被提出用于降低其发生率，尤其是在高风险病例中。目的：比较直肠吲哚美辛、预防性胰管支架置入和标准护理在预防PEP方面的有效性和临床结局。方法：本随机对照临床试验纳入120例接受ERCP的成年患者，随机等分为3组。A组在ERCP前30分钟接受单次100毫克直肠吲哚美辛栓剂，B组使用5 Fr塑料支架进行预防性胰管支架置入，C组接受无预防的标准护理。结果：各组基线人口学特征和ERCP结果具有可比性。胰腺支架组PEP发生率（2%）显著低于吲哚美辛组（10%）和对照组（20%）（p值等于0.01）。支架组ERCP后24小时血清淀粉酶和脂肪酶浓度显著降低（p值低于0.05）。各组在胰腺炎严重程度或穿孔、胆管炎或出血等其他并发症方面差异无统计学意义。结论：直肠吲哚美辛和预防性胰管支架置入均能有效降低PEP发生率。然而，胰腺支架置入显示出更优的疗效，并与最低的PEP发生率相关，支持其作为高风险病例中最有效预防方法的作用。
items.abstract_en: Background: Post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography pancreatitis (PEP) is the predominant and clinically relevant consequence of ERCP, resulting in considerable morbidity and healthcare burden. Both pharmacologic and endoscopic prophylactic strategies have been proposed to decrease its incidence, particularly in high-risk cases. Aim: To compare the effectiveness and clinical outcomes of rectal indomethacin, prophylactic pancreatic duct stenting, and standard care in the avoidance of PEP. Methods: This randomized controlled clinical trial included 120 adult cases having ERCP, who were randomly allocated into 3 equal groups. Group A received a single 100-milligram rectal indomethacin suppository 30 minutes prior to ERCP, Group B underwent prophylactic pancreatic duct stenting utilizing a 5 Fr plastic stent, and Group C received standard care without prophylaxis. Results: Baseline demographic characteristics and ERCP results were comparable among groups. The frequency of PEP was significantly lowered in the pancreatic stent group (2%) compared to the indomethacin group (10%) and the control group (20%) (p-value equal to 0.01). Post-ERCP serum amylase and lipase concentrations at twenty-four hours were significantly reduced in the stent group (p-value under 0.05). Statistically insignificant variances were found among groups regarding the severity of pancreatitis or other complications like perforation, cholangitis, or bleeding. Conclusion: Both rectal indomethacin and prophylactic pancreatic duct stenting effectively lessen the frequency of PEP. However, pancreatic stenting demonstrated superior efficacy and was related to the lowest PEP frequency, supporting its role as the most effective preventive approach in high-risk cases.
items.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
items.summary_cn: 该随机对照试验比较了直肠吲哚美辛、预防性胰管支架置入与标准护理预防ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）的效果，发现胰管支架组PEP发生率（2%）显著低于吲哚美辛组（10%）和对照组（20%），且术后24小时血清淀粉酶和脂肪酶水平显著降低；两种干预均有效，但胰管支架置入在高危病例中预防效果更优。

items.title_cn: 常规入院变量对临床评分早期预测急性胰腺炎ICU入住和全身并发症的增量价值
items.title_en: Incremental value of routine admission variables added to clinical scores for early prediction of ICU admission and systemic complications in acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 我们评估了常规入院变量是否能为急性生理与慢性健康评估II（APACHE II）在预测急性胰腺炎患者入住重症监护病房（ICU）及全身并发症方面提供附加预测信息。本回顾性队列纳入264例患者。采用判别力、校准度、重分类及决策曲线评估终点特异性完整病例logistic模型。我们比较了纳入与排除患者，并以固定预测变量集进行了1，000次bootstrap重抽样。ICU分析纳入160例患者，发生34个事件；排除患者的ICU入住率更高（39.4%对21.3%）。在104例无精确数值C反应蛋白（CRP）值的患者中，89例记录为空，15例为检测限报告。全身并发症分析纳入226例患者，发生89个事件。联合模型与APACHE II的表观受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）分别为：ICU入住0.947对0.928，全身并发症0.968对0.962；两项差异均无统计学意义（P = 0.0958和P = 0.1536）。经乐观度校正后的联合模型AUC分别为0.937和0.962。表观无类别净重分类改善分别为0.877和0.674，综合判别改善分别为0.090和0.027。CRP选择的稳定性有限。常规变量显示出初步的增量信息，但AUC较APACHE II无显著改善。选择偏倚、事件数有限及终点异质性限制了结果的解读。探索性联合模型在临床使用前需要独立验证。
items.abstract_en: We assessed whether routine admission variables add predictive information to Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II (APACHE II) for intensive care unit (ICU) admission and systemic complications in acute pancreatitis. This retrospective cohort included 264 patients. Endpoint-specific complete-case logistic models were assessed using discrimination, calibration, reclassification, and decision curves. We compared included and excluded patients and performed 1,000 bootstrap resamples with fixed predictor sets. The ICU analysis included 160 patients with 34 events; excluded patients had a higher ICU admission rate (39.4% versus 21.3%). Of 104 patients without an exact numeric C-reactive protein (CRP) value, 89 had blank records and 15 had assay-limit reports. The systemic-complication analysis included 226 patients with 89 events. Apparent areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) for the Combined model versus APACHE II were 0.947 versus 0.928 for ICU admission and 0.968 versus 0.962 for systemic complications; neither difference was statistically significant ( P = 0.0958 and P = 0.1536). Optimism-corrected Combined AUCs were 0.937 and 0.962, respectively. Apparent category-free net reclassification improvement was 0.877 and 0.674, and integrated discrimination improvement was 0.090 and 0.027, respectively. CRP selection stability was limited. Routine variables showed preliminary incremental information without a significant AUC improvement over APACHE II. Selection bias, limited events, and endpoint heterogeneity constrain interpretation. The exploratory Combined models require independent validation before clinical use.
items.summary_cn: 在急性胰腺炎患者中，将常规入院变量加入APACHE II评分后，对ICU入住和全身并发症的预测AUC仅从0.928/0.962小幅提升至0.947/0.968，差异无统计学意义；但重分类改善（NRI 0.877/0.674）和判别改善（IDI 0.090/0.027）提示可能存在初步的增量预测信息，且CRP选择的稳定性有限，需独立验证。

items.title_cn: 慢性胰腺炎血清微量营养素浓度评估：来自全国COMBO随机试验的见解
items.title_en: Assessment of serum micronutrient concentration in chronic pancreatitis: insights from the nationwide COMBO randomised trial.
items.abstract_cn:
引言

在慢性胰腺炎（CP）患者中，胰腺外分泌功能不全（PEI）和饮食摄入不足可能导致营养不良。国际指南建议监测关键微量营养素（MN），但其临床意义仍不确定。本研究旨在评估CP患者低血清微量营养素的患病率、危险因素、并发症及纵向变化过程。

方法

这是COMBO试验的预设分析，该试验是一项关于循证CP管理的全国性阶梯楔形整群随机试验。营养生化评估包括在35个月研究期间检测维生素A、D、E和K、铁、锌、硒、钙和镁。PEI症状严重程度使用PEI问卷进行评估。

结果

在409例CP患者中，327例（80%）患有PEI。184例患者（45%）存在低血清微量营养素，其中63例（15%）存在多种微量营养素水平低下。低维生素K（59%）和低维生素D（38%）最为常见。低血清微量营养素的危险因素包括严重PEI症状（aOR 2.54；95% CI 1.04-6.18，p=0.04）和每日饮酒（aOR 3.71；95% CI 1.54-8.89，p=0.003），但吸烟和异常BMI不是危险因素。低维生素K与INR升高无关。47/166例患者（28%）被诊断为骨质疏松症，其与低钙相关，但与低维生素D或K无关。在大多数患者中，低血清微量营养素随时间恢复正常，未进行针对性补充。

结论

低血清微量营养素在CP中较为常见，与严重PEI症状和每日饮酒相关，但通常与功能结局无关。这些发现支持在临床危险因素指导下对CP患者进行针对性的生化营养评估。
items.abstract_en:
INTRODUCTION
In patients with chronic pancreatitis (CP), pancreatic exocrine insufficiency (PEI) and poor dietary intake may cause malnutrition. International guidelines recommend monitoring key micronutrients (MN), however clinical implications remain uncertain. This study aims to evaluate the prevalence, risk factors, complications, and longitudinal course of low serum MNs in patients with CP.


METHODS
This is a predefined analysis of the COMBO trial, a nationwide stepped-wedge cluster randomised trial on evidence-based CP management. Nutritional biochemical assessment included vitamins A, D, E, and K, iron, zinc, selenium, calcium, and magnesium during the 35-month study period. PEI symptom severity was assessed using the PEI-Questionnaire.


RESULTS
Among 409 patients with CP, 327 (80%) had PEI. Low serum MNs were present in 184 patients (45%), including 63 (15%) with low levels of multiple MNs. Low vitamin K (59%) and D (38%) were most prevalent. Risk factors of low serum MNs included severe PEI symptoms (aOR 2.54; 95% CI 1.04 - 6.18, p = 0.04), and daily alcohol use (aOR 3.71; 95% CI 1.54 - 8.89, p = 0.003), but not smoking and abnormal BMI. Low vitamin K was not associated with increased INR. Osteoporosis was diagnosed in 47/166 patients (28%), and associated with low calcium, but not with low vitamin D or K. In most patients, low serum MNs normalised over time without targeted supplementation.


CONCLUSION
Low serum MNs are common in CP and associated with severe PEI symptoms, and daily alcohol use, but often not with functional outcomes. These findings support targeted biochemical nutritional assessment in CP, guided by clinical risk factors.
items.summary_cn: 在409例慢性胰腺炎患者中，45%存在低血清微量营养素，以维生素K（59%）和维生素D（38%）缺乏最常见；严重PEI症状（aOR 2.54）和每日饮酒（aOR 3.71）是危险因素，而低维生素K与INR升高无关，骨质疏松与低钙相关但与低维生素D/K无关，且多数患者低微量营养素可随时间自行恢复正常。

items.title_cn: Gasdermins跷跷板在肠道稳态和消化系统疾病中的黄金时期
items.title_en: Primetime for the Gasdermins Seesaw in Intestinal Homeostasis and Digestive Disorders
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 五种成孔gasdermin蛋白（GSDMs，即GSDMA-E）最为人所知的功能是执行焦亡（pyroptosis），这是一种裂解性且高度炎症性的程序性细胞死亡形式。过去十年中不断积累的证据揭示了GSDMs在消化道稳态和疾病中的多种非裂解性功能。在生理条件下，GSDMs维持肠道屏障完整性和黏膜免疫，而其激活失调则会加剧一系列消化系统疾病中的组织损伤，包括炎症性肠病、急性肠损伤、放射性肠炎、急性胰腺炎和肝脏疾病。值得注意的是，GSDM激活的功能结局高度依赖于具体情境：同一蛋白既可发挥保护作用，也可造成损伤。这种双重性同样延伸至消化系统肿瘤学领域，GSDM介导的焦亡既可刺激也可抑制抗肿瘤免疫。GSDM靶向药物，包括GSDMD激动剂、GSDMD抑制剂和GSDME抑制剂，在临床前模型中已显示出令人鼓舞的疗效，但目前尚无一款进入临床。本文综述了GSDMs在消化系统中的双重作用，概述了其形式特异性、细胞特异性和组织特异性功能的机制基础，并讨论了GSDM靶向治疗的进展与尚存挑战。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The five pore‐forming gasdermins (GSDMs, namely GSDMA‐E) are best known for executing pyroptosis, a lytic and highly inflammatory form of programmed cell death. Accumulating evidence over the past decade has unveiled diverse nonlytic functions of GSDMs in digestive homeostasis and disease. GSDMs preserve intestinal barrier integrity and mucosal immunity under physiological conditions, whereas their dysregulated activation fuels tissue injury across a spectrum of digestive diseases, including inflammatory bowel disease, acute intestinal injury, radiation enteritis, acute pancreatitis, and liver disorders. Notably, the functional outcome of GSDM activation is highly context‐dependent: the same protein can be either protective or injurious. This duality extends to digestive oncology, where GSDM‐mediated pyroptosis can stimulate or suppress antitumor immunity. GSDM‐targeted drugs, including GSDMD agonists, GSDMD inhibitors, and GSDME inhibitors, have shown encouraging efficacy in preclinical models, although none have yet reached the clinic. Here, we review the dual roles of GSDMs across the digestive system, outline the mechanistic basis of their form‐, cell‐, and tissue‐specific functions, and discuss the progress and remaining challenges in GSDM‐targeted therapy.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出，五种成孔gasdermin蛋白（GSDMA-E）除执行焦亡外，在消化系统稳态与疾病中具有多样的非裂解功能：生理条件下维护肠屏障完整性与黏膜免疫，而失调激活则促进炎症性肠病、急性肠损伤、放射性肠炎、急性胰腺炎及肝脏疾病等组织损伤，且同一蛋白的作用具有保护或损伤的情境依赖性，并延伸至消化道肿瘤中焦亡对抗肿瘤免疫的双向调控。GSDMD激动剂、GSDMD抑制剂和GSDME抑制剂等靶向药物在临床前模型中显示疗效，但尚未进入临床。

items.title_cn: 胰腺导管腺癌中遗传改变、PTM信号传导与肿瘤微环境重塑的机制整合
items.title_en: Mechanistic integration of genetic alterations, PTM signaling, and tumor microenvironment remodeling in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
items.abstract_cn: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）是最致命的恶性肿瘤之一，具有诊断晚、进展快、治疗耐药性强和总生存率低的特点。越来越多的证据表明，PDAC的进展并非由简单的遗传事件所决定，而是取决于多种遗传易感性、翻译后修饰（PTMs）、代谢失调、慢性炎症以及肿瘤微环境（TME）的动态重塑。胚系和体细胞改变，包括KRAS、TP53、BRCA1/2、ATM和SMAD4，影响基因组不稳定性和致癌信号传导，而慢性胰腺炎、肥胖和2型糖尿病等炎症和代谢性疾病则促进腺泡-导管化生（ADM）和肿瘤起始。磷酸化、泛素化、乙酰化、甲基化和糖基化等PTMs是MAPK、PI3K/AKT、NF-κB和STAT3等信号通路的关键调控因子，影响细胞组织的可塑性、上皮-间充质转化（EMT）、免疫逃逸和治疗耐药性。与此同时，由癌相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）、细胞外基质（ECM）、免疫抑制细胞和缺氧代谢条件组成的促结缔组织增生性TME，通过与肿瘤细胞的协同信号级联放大促进肿瘤进展。本综述的目的是通过将基因组水平的改变、PTM介导的信号传导和微环境因素相关联，提供对PDAC的全面、基于系统的分析，并绘制基因组、PTM和微环境变化如何相互作用以驱动癌症、进展和治疗耐药的图谱。此外，强调了多组学分析（包括基因组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学）在生物标志物识别和精准医学中的重要性。现有研究倾向于分别研究遗传学、PTMs或TMEs，而本综述则追溯将它们连接为单一整合框架的机制线索。这使研究者不仅能够对疾病生物学有更深入的理解，还能够发现新的治疗机会。
items.abstract_en: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is one of the deadliest malignancies, with late diagnosis, rapid progression, considerable therapy resistance, and low overall survival. Growing evidence suggests that PDAC progression is not determined by simple genetic events but rather depends on a multitude of genetic susceptibilities, post-translational modifications (PTMs), metabolic dysregulation, chronic inflammation, and dynamic remodeling of the tumor microenvironment (TME). Germline and somatic alterations, including KRAS, TP53, BRCA1/2, ATM, and SMAD4, impact genomic instability and oncogenic signaling, whereas inflammatory and metabolic pathologies like chronic pancreatitis, obesity, and type 2 diabetes mellitus promote acinar-to-ductal metaplasia (ADM) and tumor initiation. PTMs such as phosphorylation, ubiquitination, acetylation, methylation, and glycosylation are among the key regulators of signaling pathways including MAPK, PI3K/AKT, NF-κB, and STAT3, affecting the plasticity of cellular organization, epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT), immune evasion, and therapeutic resistance. In parallel, the desmoplastic TME, composed of cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), extracellular matrix (ECM), immune suppressor cells, and hypoxic metabolic conditions, potentiates tumor advancement through co-signaling cascades with tumor cells. The objective of this review is to provide a comprehensive, systems-based analysis of PDAC by correlating the changes at the genomic level, PTM-mediated signaling, and microenvironmental factors, along with mapping how genomic, PTM, and microenvironmental changes interact to drive cancer, progression, and treatment resistance. In addition, the importance of multi-omics analysis, which includes genomics, proteomics, and metabolomics, for biomarker identification and precision medicine is emphasized. Whereas existing research have tended to study either genetics, PTMs, or TMEs separately, this review instead traces the mechanistic thread that connects them into a single integrated framework. This allows the researcher not only to develop a deeper understanding of the biology of diseases but also to discover new opportunities for therapy as well.
items.summary_cn: 该综述提出PDAC进展并非由单一遗传事件决定，而是由KRAS、TP53、BRCA1/2、ATM、SMAD4等基因改变、磷酸化/泛素化/乙酰化/甲基化/糖基化等PTM调控的MAPK、PI3K/AKT、NF-κB、STAT3信号通路，以及由CAFs、ECM、免疫抑制细胞和缺氧构成的促纤维增生性TME共同整合驱动，并强调多组学分析对生物标志物发现和精准医学的价值。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
